tasks.description: 1.1 Update Sales bundle selection to load and use `product_bundles.bundle_sale_price` as the parent cart row unit price.
1.2 Stop using legacy `product_bundles.price` as a Sales bundle add-on.
1.3 Add stable bundled-row metadata to cart options so later recalculation paths can detect selected bundles.
1.4 Ensure selected bundle component rows are added to cart options with non-billable price/subtotal values.
2.1 Update customer selection repricing so non-bundled rows still use customer tier pricing while bundled rows preserve their current parent row price.
2.2 Update quantity changes so bundled rows multiply the current parent row price and skip cascading quantity repricing.
2.3 Update manual parent row price edits so edited bundled row prices remain authoritative for subsequent recalculations.
2.4 Update line discount, global discount, line tax, and tax-included recalculations to preserve bundled row unit prices.
2.5 Update PKP/non-PKP reconciliation paths to preserve bundled row pricing and keep component totals non-billable.
3.1 Update Sales edit cart hydration so existing bundled rows hydrate from the parent `sale_details` price as the current editable row price.
3.2 Normalize hydrated bundle component prices/subtotals as non-billable cart context.
3.3 Update Sales create persistence so `sale_bundle_items` component rows do not persist billable subtotal amounts for selected bundles.
3.4 Update Sales update persistence so recreated `sale_bundle_items` component rows remain non-billable.
3.5 Verify `SaleNormalizer` continues deriving sale header totals from parent sale details only for bundled rows.
4.1 Keep the parent bundled cart row price editable in Sales create/update.
4.2 Hide or render bundle component item prices as read-only informational data in Sales bundle detail UI.
4.3 Ensure bundle detail labels no longer imply legacy add-on pricing.
4.4 Verify Sales show/print views do not present bundle component amounts as billable totals for selected bundle rows.
5.1 Add Sales create coverage for bundle selection initializing parent row price from `bundle_sale_price`.
5.2 Add coverage that legacy `product_bundles.price` is not added to bundled Sales row totals.
5.3 Add coverage that manual bundled row price edits are preserved through quantity, discount, tax, and customer-change recalculations.
5.4 Add coverage that customer tier and cascading quantity repricing still apply to non-bundled rows but not bundled rows.
5.5 Add Sales edit coverage for hydrating existing bundled rows with parent sale detail price and non-billable component rows.
5.6 Add persistence coverage that `sale_bundle_items` component price/subtotal values do not accumulate into sale totals.
5.7 Run targeted Sales cart, Sales persistence, Product Bundle pricing, and existing bundle dispatch regression tests.
